7603: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Desk with Laminate Top
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-7603-endurance-wall-mount-desk-w-laminate-top
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/endurance-wall-mount-desk/
Spec sheets: 7603 / 7605, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Desk with Laminate Top – 7603
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Desk with Laminate Top - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 7603
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Desk with Smooth Laminate Work Surface That Bolts to the Wall and Floor
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 7603 Endurance Wall Mount Desk with Laminate Top
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Desk with Laminate Top pairs a one-piece molded desk with a smooth laminate work surface, for a more normative look in patient rooms, residential units, and other secure settings.
The desk is rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene and bolts to the floor and wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice. The same desk is also available without a laminate top as the all-plastic Cortech Endurance Wall Mounted Desk (7605).
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene with a laminate top; no steel components
Laminate Top: Smooth laminate top in a choice of standard Formica and Wilsonart finishes
Dimensions: 36”W×24”D×29”H
Weight: 35 lbs
Mounting: Bolts to the floor and wall through concealed pilot holes
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Base Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: 5-year warranty on the laminate top; lifetime warranty on the molded desk
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
7603 – Laminate Top: 36”W×24”D×29”H, 35 lbs
Installation and Options
Mounting: Bolt to the floor and wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice; drill holes at least 2” deep; see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The Wall Mount Desk with Laminate Top suits rooms where a desk must stay fixed in place but a warmer, more normative surface is wanted.
Typical applications include:
Cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers, classrooms, and study areas
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (58 characters): Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Desk with Laminate Top - 7603
Meta description (150 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance wall mount desk with laminate top. A one-piece molded desk with a smooth laminate surface that bolts to the wall and floor.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out "One-Piece Rotationally Molded" and "Model."
Meta title: adding "at Anchortex" would make it more than 65 characters, so I left it off.
Weight: your variant is set to 50 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 35 lbs for the wall mount desk, so I used 35 lbs.
Mounting: your current page says it bolts to the floor. The Cortech spec sheet says floor and wall, so I used that.
Corrections note: your current page says the laminate top "is not generally recommended for corrections applications" and that model "7065" (all-plastic) is recommended instead. Cortech does not say this, and 7065 looks like a typo for 7605. I left it out. Would you like it kept, with 7605?
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 5 years on the laminate top and lifetime on the all-plastic desk, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 6 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
I left out "Stain resistant" and "can be wiped, mopped, or even hosed down," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these.
Product images: the page has two images. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
